summary: Import wave 2: Bayushi Kahoku and Asako Ume, the first cards using a target-dependent Attack strength conditional and an always-on passive Force Effect hook. remaining: 16 further Tier 2 candidates triaged but not shipped this round; docs/ROADMAP.md has the full per-card breakdown (5 scan-blocked, 1 exposes an Item-Battle-presence gap, 10 need a mechanism beyond strength/Force parameters, itemized in a table).
